answer: 2023-24: 2,208 LEAs surveyed; 1,579 responses recorded; stated response rate about 72%. Excluding 385 LEAs that did not offer TK, 1,823 remained and the stated response rate was 87%. 2024-25: 1,464 LEAs surveyed; 952 responses recorded; stated response rate about 65%. Excluding 26 LEAs that did not offer TK, 926 remained and the stated response rate was 95%. Thus, 2024-25 had 744 fewer LEAs surveyed and 627 fewer responses; its overall stated rate was 7 percentage points lower, while its post-exclusion stated rate was 8 points higher.
